latest.title: Staffing by the hour for offices
latest.summary: Law firms, travel agencies and the other office businesses now get the same Customers by hour grid as shops, with staff at computers as their capacity, and the same warnings when they sit at the ceiling or have staff standing idle. Offices form their own chain in the Portfolio and list their fee instead of shelves. The at-the-ceiling warning for shops and offices now names the right limit for each hour.
